disclaimer: Pricing and features change often. Facts are based on public sources checked around Nov 2025–Nov 2026; always verify on the vendor site before buying.

tools.name: Cursor
tools.pricing: Free (limited); Plus from ~$8/mo (Grok-only); Pro ~$16–30/mo; usage meters apply
weaknesses: Usage meters can surprise heavy users
tools.bestFor: Complex multi-file projects and daily vibe coding in a dedicated AI IDE

tools.name: Claude Code
tools.pricing: Minimal on Free; full access with Claude Pro from $17/mo annual ($20 monthly); Max $100–200/mo
weaknesses: Free tier too limited for real coding
tools.bestFor: Large codebases, terminal agents, and long-horizon debugging

tools.name: GitHub Copilot
tools.pricing: Free (2,000 completions + 50 chat/agent requests/mo); Pro $10/mo; Pro+ $39/mo
weaknesses: Less deep codebase context than Cursor/Claude Code
tools.bestFor: Developers who want AI in VS Code/JetBrains without switching editors

tools.name: OpenAI Codex
tools.pricing: Included with ChatGPT Plus ($20/mo) and Pro ($200/mo); API usage extra
strengths: Runs in ChatGPT, CLI, and IDE extensions
weaknesses: Heavy use may need Pro or API
tools.bestFor: OpenAI-first teams who want coding inside the ChatGPT stack

tools.name: Devin Desktop (Windsurf)
tools.pricing: Free plan; Pro from ~$15–20/mo
tools.bestFor: Budget-conscious AI IDE users and Cognition stack fans

tools.name: Replit Agent
tools.pricing: Free Starter with daily Agent credits; Core from ~$17–20/mo annual
strengths: Build and host in one place
weaknesses: Less stack control than local IDEs
tools.bestFor: Beginners and fast browser-hosted prototypes

tools.name: v0 by Vercel
tools.pricing: Free (~$5 credits/mo + daily message limits); Premium from $20/mo
strengths: Great for landing pages and dashboards
tools.bestFor: Generating production-looking UI fast, then wiring logic elsewhere

tools.name: Bolt.new
tools.pricing: Free includes token allowance; paid plans for more usage
weaknesses: Less control for large production apps
tools.bestFor: Vibe coding full apps and simple browser games from a prompt

tools.name: Lovable
tools.pricing: Free with daily build credits; paid for higher quotas
tools.bestFor: Non-engineers shipping polished web app MVPs quickly

tools.name: Aider
tools.pricing: Free open-source CLI; you pay for the model API you connect

tools.bestFor: CLI power users who want pay-as-you-go coding agents

tools.name: Continue
tools.pricing: Free open-source; bring your own models/API keys
tools.bestFor: Privacy-first or local-model coding setups

tools.name: Amazon Q Developer
tools.pricing: Free (50 agentic requests + 1,000 lines/mo); Pro from $19/user/mo
tools.bestFor: Teams deep in the AWS ecosystem

tools.name: Tabnine
tools.pricing: Free basic completions; Code Assistant Platform from $39/user/mo annual
tools.bestFor: Regulated enterprises needing private AI coding

tools.name: Zed AI

tools.name: Claude

tools.name: Grok

tools.name: Perplexity
